name: VoxArena
summary:
VoxArena is a first-person shooter played in the web browser, with a blocky voxel art style. Matches are short and focused on aiming and movement, with dashes, slides, grenades and seven weapons, including a sniper rifle with scoped aiming.

Arena modes include Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Hardpoint, Capture the Flag and Sniper Only, played online or offline against bots, on dedicated maps for each mode. A Battle Royale mode drops players into a new procedurally generated map every match, where they loot chests for gear of five rarities while the zone closes in and fight both other players and roaming monsters, solo or in squads. Players can also build their own maps in a block-based map editor, customize their character and weapon skins, join clans and climb weekly rankings.
